issues.title: Pre-existing: negative vint element length decodes an element from nil data with a nil…

This is unchanged pre-existing logic (not touched by this PR's diff) and is explicitly the #1106 case the PR's own description calls out as deferred, though that ticket number does not exist.

issues.title: Pre-existing: dimension bound misclassifies a hypothetical zero-length fixed custom type
issues.verdictReason: isVectorVariableLengthType treats any unrecognized custom element type as variable-length with a 1-byte minimum; a hypothetical zero-length fixed custom type would be non-narrowing under this bound. No such type exists in this codebase (EmptyType isn't a real vector element type here), so this is a theoretical, not currently reachable, misclassification.
issues.scopeReason: vectorElemMinSize and its classification of custom types is new code added by this PR, even though the underlying edge case is not currently exploitable.
